description: Patine: looks finished, feels native. A polished React Native component library for iOS, Android and the web from one codebase, with zero native code, in the Patine design by default or each platform's native look with one prop: buttons, text fields, dialogs, modals, drawers, tabs, accordions, collapsibles, toasts, popovers, tooltips, text, stacks, cards, lists, headers, badges, avatars, alerts, skeletons, progress bars, empty states, chat bubbles, carousels and pagers, QR codes, sortable and swipeable lists, an image viewer, a signature pad, steps, checkboxes and checkbox groups, toggle groups, button groups, links, FABs, copy buttons, search fields, number fields and steppers, bottom tab bars and navigation rails, breadcrumbs, pagination, tables, stats, description lists, keyboard keys, avatar groups, layout (Box, Grid, Container), switches, radio groups, segmented controls, chips, selects, sliders, OTP inputs, menus, action sheets, bottom sheets, and date, time, range, wheel, country, emoji and color pickers. shadcn-style API.
rules: Install patine-ui. It has zero native code (pure JavaScript), so it works in Expo Go without a rebuild.
On native, import from feature subpaths such as 'patine-ui/date' so Metro only bundles what you use.

Names and props follow shadcn/ui: variant, size, checked + onCheckedChange, value + onValueChange, and composed parts like Card + CardHeader + CardTitle. onValueChange fires for user changes only, not when value is set programmatically.

Every platform gets the Patine design (design 'brand') by default: one finished look, with each platform's behaviour. <PatineProvider design="native"> gives each platform its own (iOS, Material, web); design="ios" | "material" | "web" forces one look everywhere. A component's design prop wins over the provider's, and theme, styles and explicit props win over the design.

Every shadow comes from theme.shadows (none, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, as CSS box-shadow strings): override them in PatineProvider to restyle all components at once, or pick a level with a component's shadow prop.
Use Dialog for short content, AlertDialog to confirm, and Modal (full screen on phones, sizes, nests) or Drawer (side panel) for rich content.

In forms, use the field components (DatePickerField, TimePickerField, DateTimePickerField, DurationPickerField, MonthPickerField, ColorPickerField, WheelPickerField, EmojiPickerField, Select, CountryPicker, LanguagePicker, PhoneField): they own the open state and show the confirmed value.

Gesture components (Carousel, Pager, SortableList, SwipeableRow, ImageViewer, SignaturePad) need no Reanimated or Gesture Handler. Pro charts (LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, ComboChart, PieChart, DonutChart, RadialChart, GaugeChart, HeatmapChart, ScatterChart, FunnelChart, RadarChart, Sparkline, StatusTracker) come from @patine-ui/pro and need react-native-svg.

Pro blocks (Kanban, EventCalendar, Agenda, Gantt, Timeline, Wizard, StatsRow, PricingTable, ProductCard, ReviewList, OrderTracker, ActivityFeed, AgentActivity, AIUsageMeter) and icons (Icon with 669 names in outline/solid/duotone/color, BrandIcon with 147 brand and social logos) come from @patine-ui/pro and need react-native-svg.
